3D Mode

DAWN 3D is discoverable, optional, and clearly separated from the main content model.

The legacy ARES WebGL implementation has been repositioned as a dedicated inspection mode. If WebGL is unavailable or fails to boot, the 3D app retains its own fallback path and the main website remains fully usable.

What changed
  • ARES branding is replaced by DAWN branding.
  • Main-site integration now treats 3D as an enhancement instead of the whole website.
  • The existing WebGL architecture, loading flow, and fallback logic are preserved rather than discarded.
Launch 3D App Back to rover brief
Preview container is static on the portal page to avoid accidental scroll traps on mobile and interaction ambiguity inside an embedded canvas.
The actual 3D app launches in its own route, where the viewport can use the full screen without competing with surrounding page scroll.
Mission-ready platform

DAWN, presented with a main site first and an optional 3D inspection mode.

This rebuild keeps the public site crawlable, factual, and accessible while treating WebGL as an enhancement rather than a requirement.
